proposal.name: Make staging receipts match copied files

plan.name: Make staging receipts match copied files
plan.summary: The Python application gate will count and hash every staged regular file beneath each existing selection, including bin/ and out/, using the existing path-and-content digest format; TypeScript's HashExisting and StagePackage boundaries stay unchanged. Go and both standalone and existing-package TypeScript reports will expose the selection at their actual module, project or package staging root as FileSelection (JSON file_selection), with git or directory explained in Markdown and bound by the report fingerprint. Shared copiers will select an ignored root as a directory when its tracked files have all disappeared from the work tree, while preserving surviving tracked selections, Git error handling, submodule and nested-repository refusals, copier exclusions and strict Python application staging. SPEC.md and README.md will describe the corrected hashes, receipt evidence and deleted-file fallback, with changed SPEC bullets citing D-0054, D-0180, D-0181, D-0199, D-0278 and D-0122 as applicable. Whoever merges records the new decision refining D-0278; decision recording and checks needing unavailable Docker or network access are Merger work, and this build does not edit decisions/.

tests.name: TestPythonSnapshotExistingEvidence
tests.says: Python application existing-code receipts count and hash the staged files, including bin/tool.py and out/report.py, while TypeScript's existing-code digest keeps its current selection boundaries.

tests.name: TestDeletedTrackedStagingEvidence
tests.says: An ignored root with only deleted tracked files stages its whole allowed directory through copyTree and StagePackage, without widening ordinary Git selections or relaxing strict Python and repository refusals.

tests.name: TestGoStagingSelectionReceipt
tests.says: Go gate JSON and Markdown name the module's actual git or directory selection, including the deleted-tracked-file fallback, and the fingerprint binds it.

tests.name: TestTypeScriptStagingSelectionReceipt
tests.says: Standalone TypeScript gate JSON and Markdown name the project's actual git or directory selection, including the deleted-tracked-file fallback, and the fingerprint binds it.

tests.name: TestExistingTypeScriptStagingSelectionReceipt
tests.says: Existing TypeScript gate JSON and Markdown name the package's actual git or directory selection, including the deleted-tracked-file fallback, and the fingerprint binds it while preserving the existing-code digest.
